item.title: Cricket fraternity reacts as clinical Italy thrash Nepal to record first-ever win in T20 World Cup
item.description: Italy hammered Nepal by 10 wickets to record a historic first-ever win in the Men's T20 World Cup, producing a clinical show in only the second match of their maiden appearance in the showpiece tournament, in Mumbai on Thursday (February 12). item.title: Afghanistan cricketers pull out of PSL 2026 auction after backlash and political fallout
item.description: Afghanistan cricketers withdrew from the first Players' Auction held ahead of the 2026 edition of the Pakistan Super League (PSL), amid tensions linked to Rahmanullah Gurbaz’s signing and the political fallout between two nations. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: DDCA issues statement as video of vendor refilling soft drinks at Arun Jaitley Stadium goes viral
item.description: The Delhi & District Cricket Association (DDCA) on Thursday (February 12) issued a clarification after a video alleging vendors reusing already-poured soft drinks for resale at the Arun Jaitley Stadium went viral on social media. The clip, recorded by a fan and widely shared on X, left the spectators upset and raised questions over hygiene and quality standards at the venue. item.title: WATCH- “Kaun kaun hai photo wala”- Virat Kohli asks as he poses for photos with fans after landing in Mumbai
item.description: Virat Kohli returned to India on Thursday afternoon, landing in Mumbai to a rousing welcome from fans gathered outside the airport. The former India captain appeared comfortable and jovial as he stepped out, attracting the attention of fans wanting to see him. As cameras encircled him, Kohli originally asked for some space to make his way to his car. When he arrived in the parking lot, he handed over his bag to a member of his support team before pausing to acknowledge people waiting for photos.

item.description: India pacer Jasprit Bumrah’s brilliance on the field with the ball has earned him fans of all ages, and he has been a huge inspiration for young kids who are pursuing cricket. item.title: MS Dhoni ordered to pay INR 10 lakhs by Madras High Court related to his defamation case against IPS officer
item.description: Former India cricketer MS Dhoni has been asked to pay INR 10 lakhs by the Madras High Court for the translation of information in the defamation complaint he filed against retired IPS officer G. Sampathkumar, seeking Rs 100 crore in damages for allegedly tying him to the 2013 IPL betting scam. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “We would like a little bit more flatter wickets,” says Hardik Pandya after India’s win over Namibia
item.description: Hardik Pandya shone with both and ball as India registered their biggest ever T20 World Cup victory by a margin of 93 runs against Namibia on Thursday (February 12) at the Arun Jaitley Stadium in Delhi. The hosts smashed 100 in 6.5 overs, the fastest any team has reached the mark in the history of T20 World Cup. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “I think he will play next match,” Varun Chakaravarthy on Abhishek Sharma’s availability for Pakistan clash
item.description: India opener Abhishek Sharma missed the T20 World Cup 2026 Group A match against Namibia on February 12 in Delhi as he continues to recover from a stomach infection.
